mappings.notes: Meta Business is the asset container, not a second business entity. One FYD Business; the Meta business id becomes an ExternalIdentity claim on it.
Publishing/scheduling is Channel behavior in the adapter. No PageAgent (directive s23).
business_discovery is an adapter read path only; discovered accounts never become canonical without an owner claim.
PROPOSAL ONLY: CampaignSpec not yet defined (campaign-spec/ empty; harvest-before-defining s8). PING core never sees OUTCOME_* enums.

fyd_fields_canonical: optimization intent (mapped, e.g. LEAD_GENERATION -> generate leads)
mappings.notes: DeliveryPlan is the genuinely new sub-concept: the deterministic execution plan the compiler produces and the adapter enforces. Meta targeting DSL never enters PING core.

fyd_fields_canonical: Distribution receipt: this Creative, to this Audience, in this window, with this spend
mappings.notes: An Ad has no standalone FYD identity; it is the compiled artifact of CampaignSpec. Canonical trace is the receipt, not the object.
Meta image_hash/video_id are account-scoped; FYD Creative references media by content, adapter resolves to account handles at compile time.

PII boundary UNKNOWN: raw answers quarantined in adapter until FYD-010 rule settles. Writes are at-most-once (no idempotency); adapter lists-before-create. Retrieval needs Page token with leads_retrieval.
Empty data[] means no activity in the window, not an error; record as empty observation, never failure. Covers ads insights plus Page and IG insight edges.
The Outcome is canonical; Meta attribution of it is an Observation about the Outcome. Meta action_type strings never become FYD outcome types.
AudienceReference is the handle FYD holds; membership/hashes never leave Meta. Customer-list uploads are adapter operations under owner approval (same PII boundary question as leads).

meta_fields_adapter_private: user_data incl. hashed PII (transient, never persisted canonically)
mappings.notes: CAPI is the write path for outcomes FYD already knows. FYD records the Outcome; the adapter forwards a CAPI event so Meta can attribute.
Billing/ownership container with no FYD counterpart by design. Referenced only as the scope of adapter operations.

open_questions: CampaignSpec not yet defined: rows for Campaign/AdSet/Ad/Creative are proposals pending CampaignSpec fields (directive s8 harvest-before-defining).
Canonical metric vocabulary: no PING metric/observation schema found in workspace search; defining it is prerequisite work, not adapter work.
Lead/audience PII boundary: FYD-010 privacy gate unsettled for this path; raw lead answers and audience membership stay quarantined in the adapter.

SocialIdentity vs ExternalIdentity: directive s4 says claims->SocialIdentity but the FYD handoff records SocialIdentityAuthority as rejected and the live graph uses ExternalIdentity; s4 wording needs reconciliation.
